plan_review.notes: Fix plan for the 6 copilot-pull-request-reviewer threads was reviewed by gpt-5.4 (rubber-duck, distinct from the implementing model claude-opus-4.8) before any code was written. Two concerns raised and both adopted: (1) BLOCKING — parseHash() must strip the leading '#' from location.hash before URLSearchParams parsing or repo/session deep-links never match; (2) regression risk — loadSessions() must not unconditionally overwrite state.sessionId when the deep-linked session falls outside the fetched range; instead inject a synthetic '(outside range)' option so a valid deep-linked session is never flipped back to aggregate.

rounds.notes: code-review agent (gpt-5.4, distinct from implementing model claude-opus-4.8) reviewed the working-tree diff of the first six fixes across renderer.mjs, aggregator.mjs, sessions-db.mjs, and README.md. Verdict: 'No concerns — all six fixes are correct and complete.' Verified boot ordering (parseHash before loadRepos), dropdown/state sync without clobbering deep-links, failed-tool red rendering via .seg.err, single-pass aggregator with no double counting or dropped sessions, and the 2000 limit clamp matching the advertised max.

A second copilot-pull-request-reviewer round on the rebased branch raised 8 fresh threads; all were fixed in code (never dismissed): (1) context-window budget was an exact-map lookup returning null for un-enumerated in-use models like claude-opus-4.8/gpt-5.4-codex — added MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOW_PREFIXES + resolveContextWindow() prefix fallback matching the README's documented per-family design; (2) removed dead hookW in renderer.mjs waterfall; (3/7) renamed misleading Map toolByModel -> perModelTotals in aggregator.mjs; (4) renamed snake_case events_jsonl_path -> eventsJsonlPath in sessions-db.mjs; (5) fixed apple-metric schema (verdict under-estimated->under, hello_kitties 0.7->0.6); (6) added fixture-driven node:test unit tests (analyzer.test.mjs + aggregator.test.mjs, 15 tests) following the copilot-guards convention, exported the pure helpers, extracted aggregator sumSessionTotals(), and wired the new tests into the test:guards CI glob. code-review agent (gpt-5.4, distinct from implementing model claude-opus-4.8) reviewed these fixes and found ONE concern: computeParallelStats() sorted start-before-end on tied timestamps, so adjacent non-overlapping tool intervals ([0,10],[10,20]) overstated maxParallelism as 2. Resolved by flipping the tie-break to end-before-start plus a regression test.

Verification re-review (gpt-5.4, distinct from implementing model claude-opus-4.8) of the computeParallelStats tie-break fix. The agent executed the function on adjacent, overlapping, nested, identical, empty, and single-tool inputs and confirmed: touching intervals now report maxParallelism 1 / 0 parallel ms; genuinely overlapping intervals still report correct parallel time and peak; no new edge-case regressions. Verdict: 'No concerns.' Full npm run verify green (typecheck, lint, format, 232 guard tests incl. 15 new extension tests, 80 unit+integration, build); PR prereqs incl. this ledger validate.
